notes: «أن عبد الله بن الزبير، حدثهم» makes Ibn al-Zubayr a link (rule 5).
«حدثني عمي، ثابت بن سعيد» and «عن أبيه، سعيد» : each uncle or father with a name is one link (rule 7). «سعيد» is the third occurrence of the word; the gloss «- يعني ابن أبيض -» is left out.
Abu Bakr's later handling of the tribute is narrative in the scene, not links.
